hours.chat and email support: 8:00 to 20:00 Monday to Friday, 10:00 to 16:00 Saturday, closed Sunday (US Eastern time)
hours.phone support: 9:00 to 17:00 Monday to Friday (US Eastern time)
hours.warehouse dispatch: orders placed before 14:00 on a weekday ship the same day

contact: Chat: the chat button on every page of lumenhome.example

faq.q: How do I reset my password?
faq.a: Go to the sign-in page and click Forgot password. Enter your account email. Open the reset link we email you within 15 minutes and choose a new password. The link works for 24 hours.

faq.q: How do I change my email address?
faq.a: Sign in, open Account, then Profile, and click Change email. We send a confirmation link to the new address; the change applies once you click it.

faq.q: How do I get a refund?
faq.a: Open Orders, pick the order and click Return or refund. Unused items can be returned within 30 days of delivery. Refunds go back to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days after the item reaches our warehouse.

faq.q: Where is my order?
faq.a: Open Orders and click Track. The tracking number appears once the order ships. Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days; express takes 1 to 2 business days.

faq.q: How do I cancel my order?
faq.a: Open Orders and click Cancel order. You can cancel until the order ships, which is usually the same day for orders placed before 14:00. After it ships, return it for a refund instead.

faq.q: How do I cancel my subscription?
faq.a: Open Account, then Subscriptions, and click Cancel subscription. It stays active until the end of the billing month and is not renewed. There is no cancellation fee.

faq.q: How do I change my shipping address?
faq.a: Before the order ships: open Orders, pick the order and click Edit address. After it ships, contact support with the tracking number.

faq.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
faq.a: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal and gift cards.

faq.q: Do you ship internationally?
faq.a: We ship to the US and Canada only. Shipping to Canada takes 5 to 8 business days.

faq.q: How much does shipping cost?
faq.a: Standard shipping is free on orders over $50 and $5.99 otherwise. Express shipping is $14.99.

faq.q: My item arrived damaged. What do I do?
faq.a: Open Orders, pick the order, click Report a problem and add a photo. We send a replacement or a full refund, and you do not need to return the damaged item.

faq.q: How do I update my payment method?
faq.a: Sign in, open Account, then Payment methods. Add the new card and set it as default.

faq.q: How do I delete my account?
faq.a: Open Account, then Privacy, and click Delete account. We delete your data within 30 days. Open orders must be finished or cancelled first.

faq.q: How do I use a gift card?
faq.a: Enter the gift card code at checkout under Payment. Gift cards never expire.

faq.q: Do you offer a warranty?
faq.a: Every product has a 2-year warranty against defects. Open Orders, pick the order and click Warranty claim.

faq.q: Can I change my order after I place it?
faq.a: You can edit the items or the address until the order ships. Open Orders, pick the order and click Edit order.

faq.q: How do I contact a person?
faq.a: Use chat or email during support hours, or call 1-800-555-0142 during phone hours. Chat replies usually come within 5 minutes.

faq.q: I did not get the confirmation email.
faq.a: Check your spam folder first. Then open Orders: every order is listed there even without the email. You can resend the confirmation from the order page.

faq.q: Do you price match?
faq.a: We do not price match. We do refund the difference if our own price drops within 14 days of your order.

faq.q: How do I apply a discount code?
faq.a: Enter the code at checkout under Discount code and click Apply. Only one code can be used per order.

policies: Returns: unused items within 30 days of delivery; return shipping is free with the prepaid label.
Refunds: to the original payment method, 5 to 7 business days after the return arrives.
Subscriptions: billed monthly; cancel any time, no fee.
Privacy: we never sell customer data.
